name: Helotes
seo_title: Helotes Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 6 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: 6 Christmas events for kids in Helotes, TX for 2026, 2 free: Helotes Hill Country Christmas Parade and Helotes Lighting of the Lights.
lede: Helotes does Christmas in Old Town and along Bandera Road, with a city tree lighting, a lighted parade in the streets of Old Town and small-business Santa days. It is a Hill Country town northwest of San Antonio, so families can mix local events with a trip into the city.
celebrates: The City of Helotes opens the season with its Lighting of the Lights at City Hall on Bandera Road, where local elementary school choirs and the Helotes Area Community Band perform before the city's Christmas tree is lit. A week later the Helotes Hill Country Christmas Parade fills Old Town with lights, music and floats, and each year brings a new theme. In between, local businesses add their own Santa pictures, festivals and markets, and the city's First Responders Breakfast with Santa, which uses free tickets for residents, is a December tradition too. The Helotes Chamber of Commerce keeps a community calendar of these events.
lastyear: In 2025 the parade was called Journey to the North Pole and rolled through Old Town Helotes on Saturday, December 13, from 7 to 8 pm, with registration for entries opening ahead of time. The city's Lighting of the Lights took place on Friday, December 5, from 6 to 7:30 pm at City Hall, 12951 Bandera Road. In 2024 the parade theme was classic Christmas movies, and each float was meant to bring a beloved holiday film to life on a Saturday night in mid December.
facts: Helotes gets its name from the Spanish word elotes, which means corn, according to Visit Helotes, and it has been on Texas maps since the nineteenth century. The town sits about twenty miles northwest of downtown San Antonio on State Highway 16 in northwestern Bexar County. In 1946 John T. Floore opened Floore Country Store at 14492 Old Bandera Road, a dance hall and grocery that later hosted Willie Nelson, according to the Handbook of Texas.
trains: Helotes itself has no railroad station, so train fans head into San Antonio. Amtrak's San Antonio station at 350 Hoefgen Street is served by the Sunset Limited and the Texas Eagle. The Texas Transportation Museum in San Antonio runs weekend train rides on the Longhorn and Western Railroad, and the San Antonio Railroad Heritage Museum in Elmendorf is open Saturdays. Farther north in Cedar Park, the Austin Steam Train Association runs the Hill Country Flyer and the North Pole Flyer.

faq: When is the Helotes Christmas parade?

The City of Helotes lists its 2026 Hill Country Christmas Parade, The Music of Christmas, on Saturday, December 12, from 7 to 8 pm in Old Town Helotes. It has been held on a Saturday in mid December in recent years, with themes such as Journey to the North Pole in 2025.
Where is the Helotes tree lighting?

The Lighting of the Lights takes place at Helotes City Hall, 12951 Bandera Road. It features performances by local elementary school choirs and the Helotes Area Community Band before the city's Christmas tree is lit.
Where can kids see Santa in Helotes?

Santa appears at several local events, including photos at The Tilted Cactus Boutique on Riggs Road and the city's First Responders Breakfast with Santa, which is for registered residents. Check the Helotes Chamber calendar for new additions.
Why is the town called Helotes?

Visit Helotes says the name comes from the Spanish word elotes, meaning corn. The town has been on Texas maps since the nineteenth century and lies about twenty miles northwest of downtown San Antonio.

It is a historic dance hall and country music venue at 14492 Old Bandera Road that John T. Floore opened in 1946. In the 1960s Floore began a long association with Willie Nelson, according to the Handbook of Texas.
highlights: The Meadows Original Frozen Custard hosts a Grinch Christmas Festival on November 27 and a Hill Country Hallmark Christmas Festival on December 4, both from 5 to 9 pm at 14108 Bandera Road.
Photos with Santa at The Tilted Cactus Boutique on Riggs Road are on Saturday, December 5, 2026, per the Helotes Chamber listing.
Christmas in Old Town Helotes Kids Markets, where children run their own booths, is on December 12 from 5 to 9 pm at 14391 Old Bandera Road, per Kids Markets.
The City of Helotes Christmas parade, The Music of Christmas, is on Saturday, December 12, from 7 to 8 pm in Old Town, and Lighting of the Lights is Friday, December 4, at City Hall.
